audit_scope: Independent audit of input isolation, image transport, tool calls, saved traces, and visible original-plan correspondence. No BIM, GT, or model call was used by this audit.

transport.detail_input_boundary: The isolated detail input contains the selected original image and local question; it contains no source BIM, prior wall geometry, candidate, history, evaluation, or GT. The question supplies only the previous R21/R06 region localization and asks the model to re-establish physical geometry.
transport.tool_log: detail_01/tools.jsonl records read-only inputs/view_image/preview_space_trace/select_space_trace calls. No mutation tool appears.

execution.tool_sequence: inputs, six view_image calls, preview trace_001, preview trace_002, select trace_002

independent_findings.subject: target identity
independent_findings.evidence: trace_001 encloses the small cabinet room at the prior R21 location and trace_002 encloses the two-table room at the prior R06 location. Neither trace selects the full-width northern room or a furniture outline.

independent_findings.subject: north exterior anchor correction
independent_findings.result: the model's approximately 150/151 px north exterior reference is supported; the auditor retracts the earlier approximately 128-135 px claim
independent_findings.evidence: A direct row profile over x=235..624 finds only 18-28 nonblack pixels per row at y=127..140, belonging to the north door leaf/arc and sparse marks. At y=150 and 151 it finds 318 and 320 nonblack pixels, followed by 308-314 pixels across y=153..160, corresponding to the full-width gray exterior wall. Thus y=127..135 is not the full-width north wall.

independent_findings.subject: shared horizontal wall
independent_findings.evidence: Both saved trace images place the common small-room/two-table-room wall at approximately y=370 px within the visible horizontal wall band. This is the one consistently useful partition coordinate in the observation.

independent_findings.subject: west representative wall
independent_findings.evidence: Both traces use x=450 px, while the visible west wall/door frame occupies a band and the plan's 4.18 m + 1.64 m width chain places the right corridor representative division near x=460 under the trace's own 248..612 px overall frame. The trace does not reconcile its x=450 choice with that chain or a declared face offset.

independent_findings.subject: east exterior wall
independent_findings.evidence: The traces declare x=612 px as the east exterior anchor but terminate both room polygons at x=605 px, producing world x=9.807692 rather than the declared 10 m exterior plane. No explicit inner-face offset is supplied.

independent_findings.subject: small-room corridor door
independent_findings.evidence: trace_001 uses x=450, y=300..330. In the saved overlay the orange segment begins at the north wall and ends partway along the visible swing/opening region instead of joining the two visible jamb limits; it follows only an upper portion of the aperture evidence.

independent_findings.subject: two-table-room corridor door
independent_findings.evidence: trace_002 uses x=450, y=400..430. In the saved overlay the orange segment begins within the swing region and continues beyond the visible lower jamb into the solid west wall; it is not the two jamb endpoints.

independent_findings.subject: two-table-room south wall
independent_findings.evidence: trace_002 places it at y=595 px/world y=7.808219 and itself reports no cross-check. The visible wall band and the plan's right-side dimension chain support a boundary near world y=8.06, so the submitted line remains materially unresolved.

independent_findings.subject: east windows
independent_findings.evidence: Both trace JSON files contain only one opening named corridor_door. The final text says the windows were included in crops, but neither east window was encoded in a trace.

application_verdict.reason: The target rooms and shared wall are localized, but the west/east reference planes, two corridor door endpoints, larger room south wall, and requested windows are not established consistently enough to update the source BIM.
application_verdict.preserve: Keep the R21/R06 identity and approximately y=370 px shared-wall observation as evidence for the next constrained measurement; do not use either complete trace as source geometry.
